The August 2024 Warrants expired on September 22, 2026, which was 30 trading days following the date of the Company’s initial public announcement of topline data from its Phase 3 LEVEL trial.

Recent Events On August 10, 2026, we reported topline results from our Phase 3 LEVEL clinical trial evaluating TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in patients with pulmonary hypertension in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction ("PH-HFpEF").
We have completed a comprehensive analysis of LEVEL results, shared topline LEVEL data with the FDA, and have determined that we need to amend the protocol for our ongoing LEVEL-2 clinical trial.
On August 10, 2026, we announced topline results from LEVEL, the first Phase 3 trial of TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in patients with PH-HFpEF.
We shared topline LEVEL results with the FDA in August 2026, and have been granted a Type C meeting to discuss the overall development of levosimendan in PH-HFpEF.
